Escape from Apocalypse||Welcome to Escape from Apocalypse. EFA is a modification that aims to transfer all possible mechanics and gaming experience from Escape from Tarkov to Hard Truck Apocalypse. At the moment, the modification is in development, which means that many things can change over time.||Due to the technical complexity of the modification, be prepared for the fact that any instability can lead to a game crash and, as a result, a rollback of all game progress to the last save.||For better stability of the game, it is recommended to re-enter the game every few raids.||Yes, you will die and often. Remember - it's just a game. We wish you good luck!
Escape from Apocalypse||This save is incompatible with the current version of the modification!||Please start a new game.

Escape from Apocalypse||Thank you for playing Escape from Apocalypse! The modification will continue to develop, one of such innovations, the Forest location, is an exact copy of Escape from Tarkov. The creation of this location turned out to be so time-consuming that delaying the release of the modification is not the best decision, so EFA was released with only one starting location. ||The new location will bring a new territory to explore, new items, quests, merchants and game mechanics. ||It is also planned to refine existing aspects of EFA, such as shelter, crafting system and other improvements to the gameplay. ||In addition, various game events are planned, timed to coincide with any event, as well as to diversify the gameplay. For completing events, the player will be able to receive memorable rewards, which will be saved in future versions of EFA.||Follow the further development of EFA on official sources:|GitHub: github.com/KiraDesuReal|Discord: discord.gg/qKK2Efx|Forum Deus Wiki: forum.deuswiki.com||Thanks for playing!

Escape from Apocalypse||Activate Bum Mode?||Bum Mode is a more difficult mode of Escape from Apocalypse. You start without initial equipment, with a stock configuration of the car without a body and weapons and with a starting capital of 25.000 coins. Whether you can escape from a difficult financial situation depends only on you.||Not recommended if you are playing for the first time!
